description: Move @@dns_cache, @@dns_cache_lock, @@dns_max_entries, @@dns_cleanup_registered, @@dns_cleanup_proc, dns_cleanup_proc, ensure_dns_cleanup_registered, dns_max_entries / dns_max_entries=, enforce_dns_limit, clear_expired_dns, DNS_EVICTION_BUFFER, get_cached_dns, cache_dns into a new src/fetcher/dns_cache.cr class (e.g. Fetcher::DNSCache). Preserve public API: CrestHttpClient.clear_dns_cache (class+instance), CrestHttpClient.dns_max_entries / dns_max_entries=, CrestHttpClient.clear_expired_dns, CrestHttpClient::DNS_EVICTION_BUFFER, and instance debug_get_cached_dns / debug_clear_dns_cache / debug_seed_dns_cache test helpers.
title: Extract DNS cache into its own class
